scope: Assessment of the latest two agent reviews; concrete representation defects fixed before large training, proposed playing-strength gains treated as experiments.

confirmed_fixes.evidence: Per-move PP/attributes pooled as a set; Conversion first-slot flag. Zero changed choices in 208-position audit.
Shared destination scorer with public eligibility masks, including Revival Blessing and unresolved Illusion exceptions; permutation regression tests.
Hits received, cumulative faint counts, last move, Stockpile and Perish state; data rebuilt under feature version 7.

experiments.decision: 25% consistent training-only ID dropout; exact augmented PPO inputs retained. Matched imitation ablation did not establish battle-strength improvement.
Intact sets with teammate affinity, weather dependencies, item/species constraints, physical/special coverage. Held-out cores excluded; synthetic teams are not claimed human joint sets.

experiments.feedback: Use public baseline until private generalizes
experiments.decision: Private LR 1e-4, two passes, bootstrapped targets. Held-out private EV now positive, but advantage over public remains uncertain under game-block bootstrap.
Actor LR doubled to 6e-5, observed pilot KL about .008 with .02 guard. Continue to 2M cumulative v7 decisions first; no automatic 10M commitment or blind KL chasing.

experiments.feedback: More neural opponents and independent policies
experiments.decision: 50/25/25 mixture beat 75/10/15 control on broad teams and frozen imitation; core difference inconclusive. Continue this mixture experimentally. Includes an independently initialized BC policy, but not a separately trained PPO/exploiter population.

experiments.feedback: Terminal policy rollout search, preview first
experiments.decision: Top three distinct preview choices, 16 sampled worlds, terminal policy continuations. Initial 32-game trial tied plain policy. No search distillation or in-battle expansion.

experiments.feedback: Replay import for imitation, prediction and teams
experiments.decision: Observed-action records plus optional verified own decision frames and explicit complete-team sidecars. Three public replays imported; 45 action records, no full sets or imitation samples. No invented masks/sets; not used in training.
15% saved-versus-varied training component plus 10% mirrors. Pilot evaluation 256 games each; neural-heavy policy 234 wins, v6/control 220.

experiments.feedback: Public damage/speed evidence, learned hidden-set heads, adaptive hypothesis coverage
experiments.decision: Current priors still condition on moves/items/abilities only; top-three tactical hypotheses can omit real moves. A posterior must model confounded damage/order evidence and be separately calibrated. Do not claim this defect is solved or change v7 features mid-run.

experiments.feedback: More expert corrections and tactical exercises
experiments.decision: Existing DAgger collector remains available; no new weak-search labels. Three simulator-verified terminal exercises were all solved, so no repetitive curriculum training added. Hazard entry, safe setup and win-condition preservation exercises remain future work.

experiments.feedback: Track weaknesses by opponent and team family
experiments.decision: Training metrics and frozen validation records retain family/opponent breakdowns; new descriptive summary tool avoids treating correlated games as independent evidence.

promotion: Frozen v6 remains baseline. V7 pilots have no conclusive gains over it on both broad and held-out-core schedules. Fresh test_v7 remains unused.
